text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The summer training camp was progressing smoothly. Meanwhile—
choice_data_list: How was that run where you focused on your closing kick?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Not quite it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When I try to save energy for the second half,
I can't run all out... and it's so frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Besides, in a battle of late-race bursts—I can't beat Cesario or Messiah.
choice_data_list: I see... In that case, I'll think of another approach.
I see... In that case, I'll think of another way.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Still though,
finding your own weapon really is tough."
choice_data_list: ...You've gotten so much stronger!
...You're getting so much stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I've definitely grown through the process so far. But—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: To beat those monsters, I need more... I need another distinct, undeniable edge.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A weapon that can rival them—
I'll definitely find my very own weapon!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...It's not enough—
More, I need more...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I must become... fast and strong.
I have to find a weapon that is uniquely mine—
one that allows me to defeat those people...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —...Can something like that really be found?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In someone as ordinary and tiny as me...
where... could such power possibly exist?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Ah!! Messiah-sa~n!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In search of that "one-of-a-kind" something—
Days of trial and error with Daring Heart.
Then, one evening...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
There you are!
Heart-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Did you just finish training?
Good work out there!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
By the way...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"If Cesario and Messiah are both together...
Am I the only one left out? Boo-hoo..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah~! No, it's not! We're doing it now!
I came to pick Heart-san up!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: How about an evening picnic together? You're welcome to join too, Trainer, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I found this place while out on a walk
with Craft. Nice spot, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You're right!
The sea breeze feels so good... doesn't it, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I suppose so...
Yeah, that's true...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...What about you, Messiah-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
......Yes.
I think it's, wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though my heart is being soothed...
......

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Gathering like this really brings back memories of the Oka Sho~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right! That intense race...
has gripped my heart and won't let go.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I want us all to clash our hearts against each other again"!
That's my motivation right now!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And soon, it's race time!
We can all... compete against each other again...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Speaking of which...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I... won't be able to run in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: So you mean...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I ended up getting injured.
I've been waiting to see how it goes, but...
For the sake of the future, I think I should make a decision sooner rather than later.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Heart-san.
Even though you were looking forward to it so much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about me!
Are you okay... with your injury?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it doesn't hurt, and I can jog lightly.
Though... it looks like it'll be a long break, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Is that... so...
......

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward to the Shuka Sho, too...
So when it came to light,
I was honestly pretty shocked, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I'm thinking positively now.
Once summer training camp is over, I think I'll spend my days off
teaching kids at a junior development club."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's awesome! Creating the future was
your dream... and this is the first step!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, you're right.
Cesario is... stepping forward into her next dream."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to pass it on to someone someday too,
but... I'm sure that's still a long ways off."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. First of all...
I need to focus on the race right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Right. Let's talk more about your coaching dreams another time!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Here's an idea from me! Why don't we run a little? After all, we're all gathered here together!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Cesario, will you come too?
Even just watching would mean a lot.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, as long as it's light running, I'm totally fine.
—Let's run together, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Craft,
if you go that close to the water's edge...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah~~!?
It got on my shoes~~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's 'cause you let your guard down!
If it were me, I'd push it right to the very edgeâ
...Eeeek?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sheesh, you too, Heart-san...?
...Hehe, whatever shall we do,
Messiah-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. It looks like we're
going to need a lot of towels.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, ahaha...!
choice_data_list: (She really... looks like she's having fun.)
(She really... looks like she's having fun.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every moment spent with her rivals is something Daring Heart enjoys from the bottom of her heart—
and undoubtedly loves with all her soul.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I kept you waiting quite a bit, didn't I?
Were you bored?
choice_data_list: Not at all. Even so, you were really having a blast.
Not at all. Even so, you were really having a blast.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
With that group, Cesario and Messiah keep everyone in line, right?
So I tend to let loose and take my limiter right off♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Don't you think I'm really lucky?
Every single day is just the happiest.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When you think about that...
Cesario really is amazing, isn't she?
choice_data_list: But... why?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
She's completely shifted her mindset.
If it were me... I might not recover for a while.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Because "right now" only happens once, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And yet, not being able to run with everyone for a while...
I don't even want to imagine it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Still... having the wonderful dream of coaching is likely what helped Cesario get back on her feet, don't you think?"
choice_data_list: Could it be... you're interested in coaching too?
Could it be... you're interested in coaching too?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, someday!
After all, isn't it wonderful? Helping someone else shine, that is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Well, for me... that would be very far off,
a terribly distant future, though."
choice_data_list: For you... right now is what matters the most, isn't it?
Right now is what matters most to you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I don't even want to think about anything other than right now!
So... bye-bye to the future!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, it's the Shuka Sho waiting right before me.
...I want to win it.
Even if the distance makes it tough for me, you know?"
choice_data_list: Sorry, I haven't been able to make a convincing proposal.
I'm sorry. I haven't been able to make a convincing proposal...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No, you're putting a lot of thought into it.
And yet, if you still can't find it... then as expected—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So I... lack confidence. I feel that no matter what, I can never surpass those girls.
choice_data_list: Heart...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her rivals possess formidable strengths.
However, if she loses confidence by comparing herself to them...
she won't be able to bring out her own best qualities either.
choice_data_list: (I mean, her greatest quality is—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Got a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the next moment—Daring Heart
gently pulled up alongside my shoulder.
choice_data_list: Heart... —?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just for 10 seconds.
Being by your side... is calming.
choice_data_list: ...If it's within 20 seconds, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for earlier.
Thanks to you, I feel refreshed.
choice_data_list: Alright, back to trial and error once more...
Alright, back to trial and error once more...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Trial and error... Hehe.
Just like back in the Junior Class...—"
choice_data_list: ...Heart?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I remembered.
Everything you did for me
heading into the Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You told me that... I'm fine
just the way I am now, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—"I love your brave running."
Surely, that's what it was.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even if I scramble to gather extra weapons, I won't know how to use them.
In that case... I'll just hold tight to what matters most to me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm not particularly versatile. But if there's something I can take pride in,
I will... push it to its absolute limits.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just like you.
—Just like you did for me.
choice_data_list: Well then...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"My weapon is—this heart that keeps enjoying the moment.
A “Daring heart” is my weapon!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Feelings alone aren't enough to win.
However... a honed and polished heart is—
choice_data_list: It becomes the strength to keep moving forward without breaking, even in adversity.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Against rivals, and against the distance.
Persevere, challenge again and again—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Surpass your limits and seize victory!
choice_data_list: Alright, then right away, let's—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! If you want to polish that weapon of yours,
there's only one thing to do."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ――Mountain training!
